grammar.pattern: V短语 / 主谓短语 + 的 + 名词
grammar.purpose: Identify which item a description refers to
grammar.explanation: 通往村里的路 has a verb phrase modifying 路. 朋友推荐的旅馆 has a subject–predicate phrase 朋友推荐 modifying 旅馆. State 的 before the head noun in these expanded descriptions. A recommendation identifies the hotel; it does not guarantee availability.

examples.zh: 通往村里的路今天开放。
examples.py: tōng wǎng cūn lǐ de lù jīn tiān kāi fàng .
examples.en: The road leading to the village is open today.

examples.zh: 朋友推荐的旅馆还没订。
examples.py: péng you tuī jiàn de lǚ guǎn hái méi dìng .
examples.en: The hotel recommended by the friend is not yet booked.

examples.zh: 我们昨天看过的路线图在这里。
examples.py: wǒ men zuó tiān kàn guò de lù xiàn tú zài zhè lǐ .
examples.en: The route diagram we saw yesterday is here.

commonMistakes.right: 朋友推荐的旅馆还没订。
commonMistakes.why: Use 的 to make the full subject–predicate phrase a modifier of 旅馆.

grammar.pattern: 前一动作作方式 / 后一动作作目的
grammar.purpose: Read how or why the linked actions occur
grammar.explanation: 坐车去村里 links the method 坐车 to going. 去村里了解农业 links going to its purpose. 拿手机查路线 uses holding/using the phone as a means of checking. These share an actor; do not infer that the trip has happened just because its purpose is stated.

examples.py: wǒ zuò chē qù cūn lǐ .
examples.en: I go to the village by vehicle.

examples.py: wǒ men qù cūn lǐ liǎo jiě nóng yè .
examples.en: We go to the village to learn about agriculture.

examples.py: tā ná shǒu jī chá lù xiàn .
examples.en: She uses her phone to check the route.

commonMistakes.wrong: 我们去村里了解农业，所以已经了解了。
commonMistakes.right: 我们去村里了解农业，是说明目的，还没说明完成。
commonMistakes.why: A purpose does not establish that the knowledge has been acquired.

lines.zh: 周六去你姐姐住的村里，还按昨天那条路线走吗？
lines.py: zhōu liù qù nǐ jiě jie zhù de cūn lǐ , hái àn zuó tiān nà tiáo lù xiàn zǒu ma ?
lines.en: For Saturday's trip to your sister's village, are we still following yesterday's route?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 她刚打来电话，说西边那条路在修，要从东边过去。
lines.py: tā gāng dǎ lái diàn huà , shuō xī biān nà tiáo lù zài xiū , yào cóng dōng biān guò qù .
lines.en: She just called. The western road's being repaired, so we need to approach from the east.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我们先坐火车，再换汽车？
lines.py: wǒ men xiān zuò huǒ chē , zài huàn qì chē ?
lines.en: Train first, then a bus?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 对。九点到车站，九点半有一班去村里的车。
lines.py: duì . jiǔ diǎn dào chē zhàn , jiǔ diǎn bàn yǒu yī bān qù cūn lǐ de chē .
lines.en: Yes. We reach the station at nine; a bus to the village leaves at nine thirty.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 朋友推荐的旅馆呢？我想住一晚。
lines.py: péng you tuī jiàn de lǚ guǎn ne ? wǒ xiǎng zhù yī wǎn .
lines.en: What about the inn our friend recommended? I'd like to stay overnight.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 就在村口，我姐姐说还有房间。我们今天打电话问问。
lines.py: jiù zài cūn kǒu , wǒ jiě jie shuō hái yǒu fáng jiān . wǒ men jīn tiān dǎ diàn huà wèn wèn .
lines.en: It's at the village entrance. My sister says there are rooms left. Let's call today.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好。第二天我想去看看河边，听说那里很安静。
lines.py: hǎo . dì èr tiān wǒ xiǎng qù kàn kàn hé biān , tīng shuō nà lǐ hěn ān jìng .
lines.en: Good. I'd like to visit the riverside the next day. I hear it's quiet.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 早上去吧。姐姐说下午来的人多。
lines.py: zǎo shàng qù ba . jiě jie shuō xià wǔ lái de rén duō .
lines.en: Let's go in the morning. My sister says more people come in the afternoon.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那别忘了叫我起床，我在旅馆容易睡过头。
lines.py: nà bié wàng le jiào wǒ qǐ chuáng , wǒ zài lǚ guǎn róng yì shuì guò tóu .
lines.en: Don't forget to wake me. I tend to oversleep at inns.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行，但你别把手机声音关了。
lines.py: xíng , dàn nǐ bié bǎ shǒu jī shēng yīn guān le .
lines.en: Sure, but don't silence your phone.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: Method, purpose and place
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 周六早上，我们坐火车到城南的小站。朋友的姐姐住在附近的村里，要在那里等我们。
lines.py: zhōu liù zǎo shàng , wǒ men zuò huǒ chē dào chéng nán de xiǎo zhàn . péng you de jiě jie zhù zài fù jìn de cūn lǐ , yào zài nà lǐ děng wǒ men .
lines.en: On Saturday morning we took the train to a small station south of the city. Our friend's sister was waiting at her nearby village.

lines.zh: 我们昨天看过的路线图上有两条路。西边的路短一些，可是正在修，只能走东边。
lines.py: wǒ men zuó tiān kàn guò de lù xiàn tú shàng yǒu liǎng tiáo lù . xī biān de lù duǎn yī xiē , kě shì zhèng zài xiū , zhǐ néng zǒu dōng biān .
lines.en: Yesterday's map showed two roads. The western one was shorter but under repair, so we took the eastern one.

lines.zh: 九点半的汽车还没来，朋友先去买水。我站在车站外，发现天上的云越来越厚。
lines.py: jiǔ diǎn bàn de qì chē hái méi lái , péng you xiān qù mǎi shuǐ . wǒ zhàn zài chē zhàn wài , fā xiàn tiān shàng de yún yuè lái yuè hòu .
lines.en: The nine-thirty bus hadn't arrived yet. My friend went for water; outside the station I noticed the clouds thickening.

lines.zh: 到了村口，姐姐拿着伞来接我们。她笑着说，幸好早上没有急着去河边，不然现在都湿了。
lines.py: dào le cūn kǒu , jiě jie ná zhe sǎn lái jiē wǒ men . tā xiào zhe shuō , xìng hǎo zǎo shàng méi yǒu jí zhe qù hé biān , bù rán xiàn zài dōu shī le .
lines.en: At the village entrance his sister met us with umbrellas. She said it was lucky we hadn't rushed to the river that morning, or we'd be soaked now.

lines.zh: 我们先把包放进旅馆，再去她家吃饭。下午雨停了，三个人一起走到河边。
lines.py: wǒ men xiān bǎ bāo fàng jìn lǚ guǎn , zài qù tā jiā chī fàn . xià wǔ yǔ tíng le , sān gè rén yì qǐ zǒu dào hé biān .
lines.en: We put our bags in the inn, then ate at her house. After the rain stopped that afternoon, the three of us walked to the river.

lines.zh: 第二天回来时，修路的地方还没开。我们又坐同一班车，手机里却多了几十张照片。
lines.py: dì èr tiān huí lái shí , xiū lù de dì fāng hái méi kāi . wǒ men yòu zuò tóng yī bān chē , shǒu jī lǐ què duō le jǐ shí zhāng zhào piān .
lines.en: The road still hadn't reopened when we returned the next day. We took the same bus, with dozens more photos on our phones.

choices: They reach the village by the eastern road and visit the river after rain
They spend the entire weekend at the station
questions.answer: They reach the village by the eastern road and visit the river after rain

questions.q: When do they actually walk to the river?

choices: They avoided getting soaked in rain
questions.answer: They avoided getting soaked in rain

lines.zh: 你说村口的旅馆好找，我怎么走到河边了？
lines.py: nǐ shuō cūn kǒu de lǚ guǎn hǎo zhǎo , wǒ zěn me zǒu dào hé biān le ?
lines.en: You said the inn was easy to find. How did I end up by the river?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你是不是只看见我发的照片，没看地址？
lines.py: nǐ shì bú shì zhǐ kàn jiàn wǒ fā de zhào piān , méi kàn dì zhǐ ?
lines.en: Did you look at the photo I sent and miss the address?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 照片很好看嘛。
lines.py: zhào piān hěn hǎo kàn ma .
lines.en: It was a lovely photo.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 看照片去旅行，难怪你总找不到路。
lines.py: kàn zhào piān qù lǚ xíng , nán guài nǐ zǒng zhǎo bù dào lù .
lines.en: Travelling by photos explains why you're always lost.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 行，我现在看地址。你别再发猫的照片了。
lines.py: xíng , wǒ xiàn zài kàn dì zhǐ . nǐ bié zài fā māo de zhào piān le .
lines.en: Fine, I'm checking the address now. Stop sending cat photos.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那你赶快回来，猫已经占了你的位置。
lines.py: nà nǐ gǎn kuài huí lái , māo yǐ jīng zhàn le nǐ de wèi zhì .
lines.en: Hurry back then. The cat's taken your seat.
lines.speaker: b

lines.en: You said the inn was easy to find. How did I end up by the river?

lines.py: běi bù de dōng tiān tōng cháng gèng lěng .
lines.en: Winters in the north are usually colder.

lines.zh: 这个地区的东部经常下雨。
lines.py: zhè gè dì qū de dōng bù jīng cháng xià yǔ .
lines.en: It often rains in the eastern part of this region.

lines.zh: 我们明天去城市东部看朋友。
lines.py: wǒ men míng tiān qù chéng shì dōng bù kàn péng you .
lines.en: We'll visit a friend in the eastern part of the city tomorrow.

lines.zh: 南部的天气比这里暖和。
lines.py: nán bù de tiān qì bǐ zhè lǐ nuǎn huo .
lines.en: The weather in the south is warmer than here.

lines.zh: 地图上南部有一条河。
lines.py: dì tú shàng nán bù yǒu yī tiáo hé .
lines.en: There's a river in the southern part of the map.

lines.zh: 城市西部有一个很大的公园。
lines.py: chéng shì xī bù yǒu yī gè hěn dà de gōng yuán .
lines.en: There's a large park in the western part of the city.

lines.zh: 她家住在这个地区的西部。
lines.py: tā jiā zhù zài zhè gè dì qū de xī bù .
lines.en: Her home is in the western part of this region.

lines.zh: 地图中部那个地方就是车站。
lines.py: dì tú zhōng bù nà gè dì fāng jiù shì chē zhàn .
lines.en: That place in the centre of the map is the station.

lines.zh: 我们在公园中部见面。
lines.py: wǒ men zài gōng yuán zhōng bù jiàn miàn .
lines.en: We'll meet in the middle of the park.

lines.zh: 这个地区有很多小村。
lines.py: zhè gè dì qū yǒu hěn duō xiǎo cūn .
lines.en: This region has many small villages.

lines.zh: 不同地区的生活习惯不完全一样。
lines.py: bù tóng dì qū de shēng huó xí guàn bù wán quán yī yàng .
lines.en: Living habits differ between regions.

lines.zh: 我们学校在这个区。
lines.py: wǒ men xué xiào zài zhè gè qū .
lines.en: Our school is in this district.

lines.zh: 我想找离这个区近一点的房间。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng zhǎo lí zhè gè qū jìn yī diǎn de fáng jiān .
lines.en: I'd like a room a little nearer this district.

lines.zh: 我想去别的城市住一段时间。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng qù bié de chéng shì zhù yī duàn shí jiān .
lines.en: I'd like to live in another city for a while.

lines.zh: 这座城市的晚上很安静。
lines.py: zhè zuò chéng shì de wǎn shang hěn ān jìng .
lines.en: This city is quiet at night.

lines.zh: 爷爷明天进城看医生。
lines.py: yé ye míng tiān jìn chéng kàn yī shēng .
lines.en: Grandpa's going into town to see a doctor tomorrow.

lines.zh: 周末我们出城看朋友。
lines.py: zhōu mò wǒ men chū chéng kàn péng you .
lines.en: We're going out of town to see a friend this weekend.

lines.zh: 这个村有两百多户人家。
lines.py: zhè gè cūn yǒu liǎng bǎi duō hù rén jiā .
lines.en: This village has more than two hundred households.

lines.zh: 村里的人都认识我姐姐。
lines.py: cūn lǐ de rén dōu rèn shi wǒ jiě jie .
lines.en: Everyone in the village knows my sister.

lines.zh: 她小时候住在农村。
lines.py: tā xiǎo shí hòu zhù zài nóng cūn .
lines.en: She lived in the countryside as a child.

lines.zh: 他们想回农村住一段时间。
lines.py: tā men xiǎng huí nóng cūn zhù yī duàn shí jiān .
lines.en: They'd like to spend some time living in the countryside again.

lines.zh: 几位农民正在地里干活。
lines.py: jǐ wèi nóng mín zhèng zài de lǐ gàn huó .
lines.en: Several farmers are working in the fields.

lines.zh: 她的父母都是农民。
lines.py: tā de fù mǔ dōu shì nóng mín .
lines.en: Both her parents are farmers.

lines.zh: 他学习农业，想回家种菜。
lines.py: tā xué xí nóng yè , xiǎng huí jiā zhǒng cài .
lines.en: He's studying agriculture and wants to return home to grow vegetables.

lines.zh: 这个地区主要发展农业。
lines.py: zhè gè dì qū zhǔ yào fā zhǎn nóng yè .
lines.en: This region primarily develops agriculture.

lines.zh: 北京是中国的首都。
lines.py: běi jīng shì zhōng guó de shǒu dū .
lines.en: Beijing is China's capital.

lines.zh: 你去过他们国家的首都吗？
lines.py: nǐ qù guò tā men guó jiā de shǒu dū ma ?
lines.en: Have you been to their country's capital?

lines.zh: 我还没去过长城。
lines.py: wǒ hái méi qù guò cháng chéng .
lines.en: I haven't been to the Great Wall yet.

lines.zh: 朋友给我看了她在长城拍的照片。
lines.py: péng you gěi wǒ kàn le tā zài cháng chéng pāi de zhào piān .
lines.en: My friend showed me photos she'd taken at the Great Wall.

lines.zh: 我们先看看哪条路线比较近。
lines.py: wǒ men xiān kàn kàn nǎ tiáo lù xiàn bǐ jiào jìn .
lines.en: Let's check which route is shorter.

lines.zh: 雨停以后，我们改了路线。
lines.py: yǔ tíng yǐ hòu , wǒ men gǎi le lù xiàn .
lines.en: We changed our route after the rain stopped.

lines.zh: 前往车站的汽车就在门外。
lines.py: qián wǎng chē zhàn de qì chē jiù zài mén wài .
lines.en: The bus heading to the station is right outside.

lines.zh: 请前往三楼的教室。
lines.py: qǐng qián wǎng sān lóu de jiào shì .
lines.en: Please go to the classroom on the third floor.

lines.zh: 这种列车可以高速行驶。
lines.py: zhè zhǒng liè chē kě yǐ gāo sù xíng shǐ .
lines.en: This kind of train can travel at high speed.

lines.zh: 这种机器不能一直高速工作。
lines.py: zhè zhǒng jī qì bù néng yì zhí gāo sù gōng zuò .
lines.en: This machine can't keep running at high speed indefinitely.

lines.zh: 这条高速公路经过三个城市。
lines.py: zhè tiáo gāo sù gōng lù jīng guò sān gè chéng shì .
lines.en: This expressway passes through three cities.

lines.zh: 雨很大，高速公路暂时不能走。
lines.py: yǔ hěn dà , gāo sù gōng lù zàn shí bù néng zǒu .
lines.en: It's raining heavily; the expressway is temporarily closed.

lines.zh: 这条铁路去年开始修。
lines.py: zhè tiáo tiě lù qù nián kāi shǐ xiū .
lines.en: Work on this railway began last year.

lines.zh: 铁路经过我们村附近。
lines.py: tiě lù jīng guò wǒ men cūn fù jìn .
lines.en: The railway passes near our village.

lines.zh: 这次飞行用了两个小时。
lines.py: zhè cì fēi xíng yòng le liǎng gè xiǎo shí .
lines.en: This flight took two hours.

lines.zh: 我第一次飞行的时候很紧张。
lines.py: wǒ dì yī cì fēi xíng de shí hou hěn jǐn zhāng .
lines.en: I was nervous on my first flight.

lines.zh: 这家旅馆就在河边。
lines.py: zhè jiā lǚ guǎn jiù zài hé biān .
lines.en: This inn is beside the river.

lines.zh: 我们已经订好了周六的旅馆。
lines.py: wǒ men yǐ jīng dìng hǎo le zhōu liù de lǚ guǎn .
lines.en: We've booked our inn for Saturday.

audio.zh: 第二天回来时，修路的地方还没开。我们又坐同一班车，手机里却多了几十张照片。
audio.py: dì èr tiān huí lái shí , xiū lù de dì fāng hái méi kāi . wǒ men yòu zuò tóng yī bān chē , shǒu jī lǐ què duō le jǐ shí zhāng zhào piān .
audio.en: The road still hadn't reopened when we returned the next day. We took the same bus, with dozens more photos on our phones.
